notes.title: Update v.1.2.2
notes.content: [list][*][p]The Deer now uses an idle animation (on one's feet.) when it is in freeze mode, making it easier to spot him.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the Deer’s damage from 55 to 40 so players with less than full HP can react after being hit.[/p][/*][*][p]For the first 3 days on free maps, the weather will always be Good, making it easier for newcomers to meet the first quota and get familiar with the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with trees on Old Castle[/p][/*][*][p]You now get 6 cooked eggs or 3 packs of nuggets from a bird egg.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: The Deer now uses an idle animation (on one's feet.) when it is in freeze mode, making it easier to spot him.

tags.balance_change: Reduced the Deer’s damage from 55 to 40 so players with less than full HP can react after being hit.

tags.feature: For the first 3 days on free maps, the weather will always be Good, making it easier for newcomers to meet the first quota and get familiar with the game.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug with trees on Old Castle

tags.feature: You now get 6 cooked eggs or 3 packs of nuggets from a bird egg.

notes.title: Update v.1.2.0
notes.content: [list][*][p]You can now restart the game immediately without needing to recreate the lobby. (Host Button Only)[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490594/f919cfa946f334722e5f73f9ca7483ff5c2811cf.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Burning barrels now provide warmth 10 times faster![/p][/*][*][p]Killed or angry aliens will now displayed as "ERROR" on the Radar Map.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490594/e67caba2aeab53aedbd72bd16dd92056963096b9.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Killed aliens now drop money (half of the normal payout).[/p][p]Please don’t try to kill them after delivery — it doesn’t make any sense.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490594/d7a0caba403f5724f0dfdcf38bedc44fbcf4519d.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Calories are now tracked not only in the food alien menu, but also for you and the fridge.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490594/ab5fa653e903702ffd95c79b6cd8dfa9304e1738.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]The quota multiplier has been reworked — it no longer increases abruptly. Instead, the growth percentage gradually decreases over time. Now there are no impossible quotas, and everything should feel fair. Stock up on food and aim for a new record!  [/p][p]The quota multiplier will decrease down to 1.2 and then stay fixed at that value. Here’s how it looks: 2.1 1.95 1.8 1.7 1.6 1.5 1.4 1.3 1.2....[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Since the game doesn't have version checking, it's recommended to avoid joining public lobbies — at least for the first few hours :) — until everyone has updated. [/u][/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: You can now restart the game immediately without needing to recreate the lobby. (Host Button Only)

tags.balance_change: Burning barrels now provide warmth 10 times faster!

tags.bug: Killed or angry aliens will now displayed as "ERROR" on the Radar Map.

tags.balance_change: Killed aliens now drop money (half of the normal payout).

tags.feature: Calories are now tracked not only in the food alien menu, but also for you and the fridge.

tags.balance_change: The quota multiplier has been reworked — it no longer increases abruptly. Instead, the growth percentage gradually decreases over time. Now there are no impossible quotas, and everything should feel fair. Stock up on food and aim for a new record!

notes.title: Update v.1.1.6
notes.content: [list][*][p]Reworked water rising behavior for the "Flood" and "Hell" weather situation. The water now rises slightly slower and can no longer rise above your bunker doors, giving you a fair chance to run in and out without being completely submerged.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the quick right-hand interaction animation would not play.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the "No Signal" overlay from dead players' cameras, as it often behaved incorrectly and could flicker.[/p][/*][*][p]Various minor game and balance adjustments.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.bug: - Fixed a bug where the quick right-hand interaction animation would not play.
- Removed the "No Signal" overlay from dead players' cameras, as it often behaved incorrectly and could flicker.

notes.title: Update v.1.1.0
notes.content: [list][*][p]Increased damage of the knife and shovel[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the angle you need to look at for the Deer to freeze[/p][/*][*][p]After Swampy deals damage, he will return to Mode 1, giving you a chance to break the sprint[/p][/*][*][p]Train ride reworked to reduce lag during world generation[/p][/*][*][p]Improved NetCode in some areas to reduce CPU usage[/p][/*][*][p]Server region window has been moved to the center[/p][/*][*][p]Dropped items no longer fly away as far[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the tunnel SEED didn't match during generation[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor tweaks and fixes[/p][p]! P.S Since the game doesn't have version checking, it's recommended to avoid joining public lobbies — at least for the first few hours :) — until everyone has updated. ![/p][/*][/list]

tags.balance_change: Increased damage of the knife and shovel
Increased the angle you need to look at for the Deer to freeze
After Swampy deals damage, he will return to Mode 1, giving you a chance to break the sprint
Train ride reworked to reduce lag during world generation
Improved NetCode in some areas to reduce CPU usage
Dropped items no longer fly away as far

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where the tunnel SEED didn't match during generation
